name: a tag at an import entry
yaml:
kind: Telo.Application
metadata:
  name: App
imports:
  Run: !if { if: true, then: ../run }

refusals.message: '!if' at 'imports.Run' of the Telo.Application document: the loader reads every import before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: a tag as the whole imports block
yaml:
kind: Telo.Library
metadata:
  name: Lib
imports: !switch { switch: a, cases: { a: { Run: ../run } } }

refusals.message: '!switch' at 'imports' of the Telo.Library document: the loader reads every import before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: a tag at an import's source
yaml:
kind: Telo.Application
metadata:
  name: App
imports:
  Run:
    source: !if { if: true, then: ../run }

refusals.message: '!if' at 'imports.Run.source' of the Telo.Application document: the loader reads every import's source before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: a repeat at an import entry
yaml:
kind: Telo.Application
metadata:
  name: App
imports:
  Run: !for-each { in: [a], emit: ../run }

refusals.message: '!for-each' at 'imports.Run' of the Telo.Application document: the loader reads every import before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: a splice among the imports
yaml:
kind: Telo.Application
metadata:
  name: App
imports:
  ...: !for-each { in: [a], key: k, emit: ../run }

refusals.message: A '...' splice at 'imports....' of the Telo.Application document: the loader reads every import before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: a tag at an include entry
yaml:
kind: Telo.Application
metadata:
  name: App
include:
  - !if { if: true, then: ./part.yaml }

refusals.message: '!if' at 'include[0]' of the Telo.Application document: the loader reads the files it includes before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: a tag at the module's name

refusals.message: '!if' at 'metadata.name' of the Telo.Library document: the loader reads the module's name before anything is expanded, so it cannot be chosen or repeated. Write it plainly.

name: tags the loader does not read are not its to refuse
every node form's range, in UTF-16 code units
yaml:
kind: Telo.Application
metadata:
  name: App # a comment
list:
  - plain
  - 'single'
  - "double"
  - { flow: map, n: 1 }
  - [flow, seq]
      # a comment indented past the list belongs to its last item
block: |
  line one
  line two
folded: >-
  folded text
tagged: !ref target
anchored: &a { z: 1 }
aliased: *a
empty:
nested:
  deep:
    - - x
  last:
    value: 1
    # a comment at the entries' indentation stays with them
after: 😀 beyond the basic plane
"😀 key": v

name: each document's start line, an empty last document included
a leading --- opens the first document
a file of comments holds no document
a key written twice
yaml:
kind: A
metadata:
  name: x
name: 1
name: 2

refusals.message: This key is already written earlier in the same mapping; a mapping holds each key once, so remove or rename one of the two.

name: an alias naming no anchor

refusals.message: This alias names no anchor written before it in the document; write the anchor (`&name`) on an earlier value, or write the value out in place of the alias.

name: an anchor does not reach a later document

refusals.message: This alias names no anchor written before it in the document; write the anchor (`&name`) on an earlier value, or write the value out in place of the alias.

name: aliases expanding past the bound

refusals.message: The aliases in this document expand into more copies of their values than a manifest may hold; write the repeated values out, or alias them fewer times.

name: a double quote never closed

refusals.message: A quoted value is never closed; end it with the quote character it opens with.

name: a single quote never closed, read on over a line too little indented

refusals.message: A quoted value is never closed; end it with the quote character it opens with.

name: a flow sequence never closed

refusals.message: A bracketed list or map ('[…]' or '{…}') is not closed, or a line inside it is not indented past the key holding it; close it with the matching ']' or '}', and indent its continuation lines.

name: a tab as indentation

refusals.message: A tab indents this line; YAML indents with spaces only.

name: a plain value holding ': '
yaml:
kind: A
description: uses encoding: base64 here

refusals.message: A plain (unquoted) value cannot contain ': ' (a colon followed by a space), which the parser reads as a nested mapping; wrap the value in quotes, e.g. `description: "… encoding: base64 …"`.

name: a line indented to match nothing beside it
yaml:
kind: A
metadata:
  name: x
 version: 1

refusals.message: This line is not indented to match the entries beside it; align it with its siblings, or indent it under the key it belongs to.

name: an escape YAML does not define

refusals.message: A double-quoted value holds an escape sequence YAML does not define; write the backslash itself as `\\`, or use single quotes, inside which a backslash is literal.

name: a plain value starting with a reserved character

refusals.message: A plain value cannot start with '@' or '`', which YAML reserves; wrap the value in quotes.

name: anything else is not valid YAML

refusals.message: This is not valid YAML; check the indentation, quoting and brackets at this position.
